segments.text: Prohibited content across all supply | Amazon Ads Support Center Skip to main content Update to Fire TV Measurement Methodology : On October 8, 2026, Fire TV is updating its measurement methodology. Reported totals will no longer include impressions and clicks that do not align with the updated measurement criteria. Across Fire TV display supply, this update impacts approximately 15% of impressions and 11% of clicks. Individual advertiser impact will vary based on campaign, marketplace, and placement mix. All Fire TV impression forecasts have been updated, and reporting will follow the updated methodology. This update is aligned with MRC standards. Updated on Jun 19, 2026 The following content is prohibited globally: Deceptive or misleading content or ad experiences, including using AI for deepfakes or content that's photorealistic but inaccurate. Hate speech or offensive, intolerant, discriminatory, or harassing content. Nudity, sexually explicit, and sexually suggestive content. Except for content deemed appropriate within the context of ad-related entertainment, art, healthcare, or science. Content that revolves around highly debated social topics. Content with minors that exploits or depicts minors in a dangerous, sexual, or otherwise exploitative manner. Ads for child-intended products may use appropriate child-related product imagery but can’t directly address children using persuasive language or interactive elements. Content that exploits critical events such as natural disasters or incidents of mass trauma or casualty. Content that exploits sensitive life events. This includes but isn't limited to pregnancy, job changes, change in marital status, medical events, or death. Unauthorized content or elements that mimic Amazon branding, color schemes, fonts, or user interface elements. Products that violate cultural norms in the locale in which they're served. Realistic depictions of bodily fluids. Ads that appeal directly to children. Content that promotes unauthorized surveillance or monitoring of a person without their knowledge or consent. Uncensored profanity, uncensored sexually explicit language, and gratuitously offensive language. Gratuitous violence, blood, and gore. This includes but isn't limited to sexual violence, violence against animals, violence towards minors, and self-harm. Was this article helpful?
